name: python
description:
Run Python code in a persistent session (variables persist across calls, like a notebook). numpy is available as `np` and torch as `torch` (CPU only, 2 threads). The model's weights are preloaded as float32 numpy arrays in the dict `weights`, keyed by name, with torch nn.Linear layout [out, in]:
  blocks.0.attn.k.bias: [384]
  blocks.0.attn.k.weight: [384, 384]
  blocks.0.attn.o.bias: [384]
  blocks.0.attn.o.weight: [384, 384]
  blocks.0.attn.q.bias: [384]
  blocks.0.attn.q.weight: [384, 384]
  blocks.0.attn.v.bias: [384]
  blocks.0.attn.v.weight: [384, 384]
  blocks.0.ln1.bias: [384]
  blocks.0.ln1.weight: [384]
  blocks.0.ln2.bias: [384]
  blocks.0.ln2.weight: [384]
  blocks.0.mlp.fc.bias: [1536]
  blocks.0.mlp.fc.weight: [1536, 384]
  blocks.0.mlp.proj.bias: [384]
  blocks.0.mlp.proj.weight: [384, 1536]
  (same for blocks.1, blocks.2, blocks.3)
stdout and the value of the last expression are returned (truncated to 20000 chars). Each call times out after 120s. No file system or network access.
